highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a prestigious public research university in a coastal city? The University of North Florida (UNF) could be your ideal choice. It offers a wide spectrum of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programmes through six colleges.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At UNF, you’ll be part of a Students' Union that’s home to nearly 200 student clubs and organisations. If you love the outdoors, you can enjoy UNF’s natural beauty, trails, and lakes, and canoe or kayak in the nearby areas.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At the University of North Florida, you can choose from seven on-campus housing options, including traditional residence halls, suites, and apartments.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
UNF’s libraries offer extensive digital and print resources, study spaces, and research support.

Sports
The Recreation & Wellness (RecWell) department is where you can find gyms, aquatics, and fitness centres. You can participate in competitive and intramural sports.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll find state-of-the-art labs across Biology, Chemistry, Data Science, Computing, and Health Sciences.

Cafeteria
You can explore various food options on campus, including the Osprey Cafe and the scenic Boathouse overlooking a lake.
